summary: The MPI kernel computes all local rows and nonzeros for every requested repetition. Extra unused global-dimension arguments do not reduce its local work.

source_evidence.claim: Remainder-aware row partitions and their complete CSR arrays are scattered. spmvMpi traverses all local rows/entries each time and is called under the original CLI iteration bound.

compiled_evidence.claim: Multiply/add a07c/a085 is retained within entry a08c, row a0a2 and iteration a0ab->a030 backedges.
